jobs.title: Senior Embedded Android Engineer- Hardware
jobs.description: Team description SumUp's Hardware Development team builds the physical products millions of small businesses rely on every day, and this role sits right at the start of a new chapter: moving our in-house hardware onto the Android platform for the first time. This isn't a typical Android device, it's a highly customised, security-first product built from scratch, which means the person joining will help define how the operating system, drivers, and secure processor come together rather than inheriting someone else's setup. The team works closely with hardware, software, and QA engineers across the bring-up process, so this role offers a rare chance to shape a product's foundations while working alongside experienced embedded and secure processor leads. What you'll do Support system bring-up for the new Android embedded platform, from bootloader through to kernel and framework Integrate and maintain kernel modules and drivers, including power management and connectivity components Contribute to build system integration across the platform Debug hardware and software issues at the protocol level and help resolve critical issues found during testing Carry out testing and validation to confirm the platform is stable and secure before release You'll be great for this role if… Experience developing embedded systems with a strong focus on Android OS, gained over several years in a professional setting Strong knowledge of the Android OS architecture, from bootloader (U-Boot, Little Kernel) and kernel through to framework and services Hands-on experience debugging hardware interfaces at protocol level, including I2C, SPI, UART, and SDIO Solid understanding of embedded security concepts such as Secure Boot, TrustZone (TEE), dm-verity, encryption, and hardware-backed key storage Comfort working with Qualcomm Snapdragon or MediaTek platforms, and expert-level C programming for embedded Linux environments Why you should join SumUp 🌎 Opportunity to work with SumUppers globally on

jobs.title: Senior Manager, Revenue Operations, DashOS EMEA
jobs.description: About Wolt At Wolt, we create technology that brings joy, simplicity and earnings to the neighborhoods of the world. In 2014 we started with delivery of restaurant food. Now we're building the delivery of (almost) everything and you'll find us in over 500 cities in 30 countries around the world. In 2022 we joined forces with DoorDash and together we keep on dreaming big and expanding across the globe. Working at Wolt isn't always easy, but it's definitely exciting. Here you'll learn more, build more, and ship more than in most other companies. You'll be challenged a lot, but also have a lot of fun on the way. So, if you're a self-starter with drive and entrepreneurial spirit, this could be the ride of your life. About the Team DashOS is DoorDash's merchant technology platform. It brings together the products restaurants and local businesses use to run their own business, sell on their own channels and keep their guests coming back, including online ordering, websites and apps, and loyalty. DashOS connects these tools with the demand and growth learnings of the DoorDash, Wolt and Deliveroo marketplaces, so merchants can grow both on our marketplaces and on their own channels. In EMEA, we are building DashOS market by market. The team is small and works like a startup within the larger DoorDash. When joining DashOS, you will help shape a new business from an early stage: what we offer merchants to fuel their growth, how we take it to market and how we support merchants once they are live. Our Strategy & Operations team builds the DashOS business end to end in EMEA: what we focus on, how we measure success, and the playbooks that make growth repeatable. We work in small cross-functional pods that find improvement opportunities, launch and iterate, together with Product, Engineering, Analytics, Finance, Legal, Marketing, our merchant and consumer teams. jobs.title: Member of Technical Staff - Safety
jobs.description: About Black Forest Labs We're the team behind Latent Diffusion, Stable Diffusion, and FLUX—foundational technologies that changed how the world creates images and video. We're creating the generative models that power how people make images and video—tools used by millions of creators, developers, and businesses worldwide. Our FLUX models are among the most advanced in the world, and we're just getting started. Headquartered in Freiburg, Germany with a growing presence in San Francisco, we're scaling fast while staying true to what makes us different: research excellence, open science, and building technology that expands human creativity. Why this role FLUX models ship as open weights, which gives anyone full access to the model. Our safety efforts focus on suppressing harmful behaviors and mitigating the risk of misuse, so safety has to be built into the models themselves, not bolted on afterwards. As a Member of Technical Staff on our safety research team, you'll research and ship methods that make FLUX models safe by design: from what goes into the training data to how the models are mid- and post-trained, across images, video and the text that conditions them. This is a role with real ownership: you won't just do research on model safety, you'll shape it. The methods you build ship in FLUX models with over 75 million downloads on Hugging Face and in production at some of the largest platforms in the world. What you'll work on Develop mid- and post-training safety methods for FLUX models, such as safety SFT, preference optimization and RL with safety rewards, and concept erasure. Build safety data filtering that runs at pretraining scale: classifiers and pipelines that screen billions of images, video clips and captions, with measured Pareto frontiers and precision/recall trade-offs. This is a hands-on role for someone who wants to learn how large-scale campaigns are built and shipped, with a clear path to grow into a campaign or project management position as you develop. PERGOLUX designs and sells Scandinavian-inspired outdoor living products, from pergolas to garden furniture, directly to consumers. We are a company that has grown consistently across Europe and beyond, with around 300 employees, 9-figure revenue, and operations across 8 markets. What You'll Do - Coordinate campaigns end to end across creative, performance, CRM, e-commerce, product and local market teams, managing request intake, the production calendar, briefs, timelines and approvals. - Coordinate localisation across markets by briefing translators and local teams, tracking translation status, and making sure localised assets go live correctly and on time. - Own asset repositories and DAM hygiene, including naming conventions, folder structures, versioning, metadata, and archiving of outdated assets. - Manage campaign trackers and boards (e.g. Jira), keeping status visible and flagging risks or blockers early. - Run and document campaign kick-offs, check-ins and retros, follow up on action items, support vendor and freelancer coordination, and propose process improvements that make delivery faster and more scalable. What You'll Bring - Strong organisational skills and the ability to keep multiple moving parts, deadlines and stakeholders on track at once. - Clear, structured communication in English, comfortable chasing inputs and keeping teams aligned

jobs.description: As an IT Security Engineer (m/f/d), you will be responsible for strengthening and protecting our organization's IT environment against evolving cyber threats. You will work closely with infrastructure, software, and operational teams to design, implement, and maintain security controls that ensure the confidentiality, integrity, and availability of our systems and data. We are looking for a hands-on security professional who is passionate about cybersecurity, enjoys solving complex challenges, and thrives in a fast-paced, innovative environment. What is your Day to Day Mission: Monitor, analyze, and respond to security events, alerts, and incidents Develop and enforce security policies in collaboration with internal stakeholders, taking into account industry-specific compliance requirements Perform system hardening and security baseline management for servers, endpoints, and critical infrastructure components. Support the deployment and administration of security solutions such as Endpoint Detection & Response (EDR), SIEM, vulnerability management, and identity security platforms. Design, implementation, and operation of firewall infrastructures using Fortinet and Sophos technologies. Manage and improve access control concepts, identity management processes, and privileged access security. Support for audits and certifications in accordance with industry-specific security standards (e.g., BSI Basic Protection, ISO/IEC 27001) IT Collaboration with national and international subsidiaries Investigate emerging threats, evaluate new security technologies, and contribute to the continuous enhancement of our cybersecurity posture. Support for user network issues. Create and maintain documentation, standards, and operational procedures. What you bring to the team: A degree in Computer Science, Cyber Security, Information Technology, or a comparable qualification. A plus would be CCNA, CompTIA+ Professional experience in IT security, system administration, infrastructure eng

jobs.description: We’re looking for a UI designer who loves casual games. You know what makes a game feel intuitive and fun to play, and you can turn that into clean, good-looking UI. You’ll be assisting the SOHO Art team and reporting directly to our Game Art Lead. Heads up: we’ll ask you to do a short graphics assignment as part of the process. What you’ll be doing: Creating UI assets - designing visually appealing interfaces that align with the game’s art direction. Matching our style - we have a very specific look. You’ll study it and create new elements that feel like part of the same family, so everything fits right in next to what we already have. Using AI tools - speeding up your work with AI: quick ideas, variations, and rough explorations. Then you polish the final assets by hand until they meet our quality bar. Helping out with general art - characters, backgrounds, props, and other 2D assets when needed. Taking feedback and running with it - we iterate a lot, and quick, smooth revisions make everyone’s life easier. Owning your work - you decide how to scope it, prioritise it, and deliver it, without needing someone to hold your hand. What we’re looking for: Experience working on casual games. Strong UI design and execution skills, with good UX instincts. Excellent 2D art skills. Strong portfolio showcasing high-quality UI art for mobile titles from concept to final in-game execution. The ability to work independently and figure out unclear problems, while taking on board feedback from the Game Art Lead. Good English so that you can explain your design decisions clearly to people from different teams. Solid skills in standard design tools like Figma and Photoshop (or similar). Comfort in a small team, where you’ll wear a few hats and switch between big-picture thinking and hands-on work. Nice to have: Any UI animation skills. Passion for games and player psychology. Dann suchen wir genau Dich zum nächstmöglichen Zeitpunkt als: Ingenieur:in Qualitätssicherung Wohnungsneubau (w/m/d) im Großraum Lübeck | Vollzeit oder Teilzeit ab 32 Stunden pro Woche Als Mitarbeiter:in in der Qualitätssicherung im Bauwesen betreust Du eigenverantwortlich Bauprojekte unserer Auftraggeber im Bereich Hochbau. Dein Schwerpunkt liegt auf Neubau und Sanierung von Wohnraum. Dabei arbeitest Du eng mit den Projektleiter:innen der Bauherren zusammen und stehst ihnen beratend zur Seite. Die Stelle ist in Vollzeit oder Teilzeit ab 32 Stunden pro Woche zu besetzen. Die sigeko-Ingenieure GmbH ist seit über 25 Jahren erfolgreich am Markt tätig und verfügt über ein erfahrenes Team von 25 Mitarbeitenden. In dieser Zeit hat das Unternehmen bereits über 2.500 Projekte erfolgreich begleitet. Der Schwerpunkt liegt auf der Tätigkeit als Sicherheits- und Gesundheitsschutzkoordinator auf Baustellen. Deine Aufgaben: Qualitätssicherung auf der Baustelle Bauvorhaben im Bereich Qualitätssicherung betreust Du eigenverantwortlich und sorgst für die Einhaltung der vereinbarten Qualitätsstandards. Hochbauprojekte mit Schwerpunkt auf Neubau und Sanierung von Wohnraum begleitest Du während der relevanten Bauphasen. Regelmäßige Baustellenbegehungen führst Du eigenständig durch und überprüfst die Qualität der ausgeführten Arbeiten. Deine Begehungen und Prüfergebnisse dokumentierst Du strukturiert und nachvollziehbar. Prüfung & Beratung Relevante Projektunterlagen wie Leistungsverzeichnisse prüfst Du sorgfältig im Hinblick auf die Qualitätssicherung. Weitere qualitätsrelevante Unterlagen sichtest und bewertest Du im Rahmen Deiner Projektbetreuung. Die Projektleiter:innen der Bauherren berätst Du fachlich zu Fragen der Qualitätssicherung und möglichen Verbesserungsmaßnahmen. Projektspezifische Prüfergebnisse besprichst Du mit den zuständigen An

jobs.title: Senior AI Content Producer - Foto, Video, Motion (m/w/d)
jobs.description: Bei Rosental Organics bist du kein klassischer Fotograf oder Videograf – du bist der Content Multiplier. Ein Shoot wird bei dir zu 50+ Assets, ein UGC-Clip zu 30 Hook-Variants, ein Produktfoto zu 20 Format-Adaptionen. Der Meta-Algorithmus belohnt Volumen und Diversität, und genau das lieferst du: aus einer Kampagne wird bei dir ein ganzer Wochen-Feed für Paid Social. Du produzierst und multiplizierst Foto-, Video- und Motion-Content für Paid Ads, Social, CRM und E-Commerce, mit klarem Fokus auf Performance und Testing-Volumen. Du drehst und shootest schnell und hands-on mit modernem Setup: UGC, Product, Lifestyle, Studio – End-to-End und ohne Assistenz-Kette. Einen skalierbaren AI-Workflow baust du selbst auf, der Rohmaterial in Dutzende testbare Variants verwandelt: Hook-Iterations, Cutdowns, Format-Adaptions, Kontext-Wechsel, Voiceover-Varianten, Motion-Loops. Du entwickelst High-Performing Creatives für Meta, TikTok und CRM mit Fokus auf Hook Rate, Watchtime, CTR und ROAS. Mindestens 3 neue AI-Tools pro Jahr integrierst du produktiv in unseren Stack (Runway, Nano Banana, Kive, ElevenLabs, Topaz, CapCut AI, Descript – was heute liefert, ersetzt du morgen). Performance-Dashboards liest du selbst, ziehst die Insights und übersetzt sie am gleichen Tag in neue Variants und Hypothesen. Du bringst 3+ Jahre Erfahrung in Content Production für D2C/ E-Commerce, Performance Marketing oder ein hochdynamisches Growth-Umfeld mit, inklusive starker Paid-Social-Cases (Meta, TikTok). Dein Portfolio zeigt echte Performance-Ergebnisse (Hook Rate, Watchtime, CTR, ROAS) und Beispiele, wie du aus einem Asset viele gemacht hast, keine Editorial-Reels, keine Behance-Moodboards. Neue AI-Tools lernst du eigenständig und schnell: Runway, Nano Banana, Kive, ElevenLabs, CapCut AI, Descript und Topaz sind dir vertraut, und den nächsten Tool-Sprung hast du meist schon selbst identifiziert. Du drehst, shootest und schneidest selbst (≥ 85 %): Sony/Canon, Studio-Light und Natural-Light, Premiere

jobs.title: Das Gesicht unserer Brand auf TikTok
jobs.description: Manche Dinge muss man nicht erklären. TRIONE ist eine Luxury Lifestyle Brand für Accessoires und Schmuck, designed in Marbella. Japanische Seidenkordel, graviertes Gold, Details, die man erst auf den zweiten Blick entdeckt und dann nicht mehr vergisst. Unser ONE Armband ist kein Accessoire, es ist ein Statement für Menschen, die nicht laut sein müssen, um gesehen zu werden. Jetzt bringen wir TRIONE auf TikTok. Nicht mit Countdowns und Rabattcodes, sondern mit Ästhetik, Haltung und Geschichten. Mit Videos und ausgewählten Livestreams aus unserem eigenen Store, von unseren Events und von Orten, die so besonders sind wie unsere Pieces. Dafür suchen wir die Person, die unsere Welt vor der Kamera spürbar macht. Deine Rolle Du bist das Gesicht von TRIONE auf TikTok, in Videos und in Livestreams aus unserem Store, von exklusiven Events und luxuriösen Locations Du erzählst die Geschichten hinter unseren Pieces, nicht ihre Preise Du gestaltest mit uns Content, der sich anfühlt wie die Brand selbst: ruhig, ästhetisch, selbstbewusst Du bist dabei, wenn eine Brand ihre nächste Ebene erreicht Was dich ausmacht Natürliche Präsenz vor der Kamera Ein Auge für Ästhetik, Fashion und Details Du verstehst TikTok und weißt, was Menschen wirklich innehalten lässt Stil, Verlässlichkeit und sehr gutes Deutsch Was dich erwartet Sichtbarkeit als Gesicht einer Brand, die man nicht übersieht Einladungen zu unseren exklusiven Events und Zugang zu unserem Netzwerk aus Creatorn und Partnern Pieces aus unserer Kollektion Ein kleines Team, kurze Wege und echter Einfluss auf das, was entsteht Flexible Zeiten neben Uni oder Job Für wen Diese Stelle ist als Pflichtpraktikum ausgeschrieben und richtet sich an Studierende, die laut Studien- oder Prüfungsordnung ihrer Hochschule ein Pflichtpraktikum absolvieren müssen. Da es sich um ein gesetzlich geregeltes Pflichtpraktikum handelt, ist keine Vergütung vorgesehen. Dafür bekommst du Pieces aus unserer Kollektion, Zugang zu unseren Events und eine Praktik

SIDES is the operating system for hospitality: POS, payments, delivery, kitchen tools, self-order terminals, apps and webshops on one platform. We have the owner's and the chef's back, so they can focus on their food and their guests. jobs.description: Lead Systems Engineer We are looking for a Lead Systems Engineer to act as the Systems Technical Authority for our orbital rocket programme. You will lead the vehicle-level systems effort, maintaining a coherent technical view of the complete vehicle and leading the definition, management, and resolution of system interfaces. Working with multidisciplinary teams across avionics, software, structures, propulsion, GNC, and more, you will manage the interdependencies between technical departments and use model-based systems engineering (MBSE) to keep system-level decisions connected. Your work will lay the technical foundation for successful vehicle integration and launch. About us We’re a Germany-based rocketry startup currently in stealth mode, scaling up rapidly to meet the demand for high-performance, reliable, and scalable solid propulsion technologies for space and defense applications. We are already launching suborbital and ballistic rockets on a regular basis, generating significant revenue and applying our knowledge toward the development of an orbital rocket. We are working hard to build something truly spectacular. To thrive here you will need to be comfortable working at pace, with the autonomy to make decisions and execute on them quickly. If you’re excited by hard technical challenges and want a role where you will make a real difference each day to the future of the company, we may be the place for you. At our company, job titles and career progression are earned, not determined by years of experience alone. They reflect the responsibility you take on and the dedication you bring to each project. If you’re ready to rise to the challenge, we’d love to hear from you. Maintain efficient and audit-ready approval processes, ensure compliance with signing authorities and internal controls, and follow up proactively on missing approvals or documentation. Administer corporate credit cards and related tools, including card issuance, user management, limits, receipt collection, transaction review, and reconciliation. Coordinate bank transactions, cash and balance sheet reconciliations, open-item management, and the preparation of supporting schedules for month-end closing. In this senior, hands-on role, you will independently run our core finance processes—from accurate bookkeeping, monthly and annual closing, tax and audit coordination through to budgeting, forecasting, management reporting, and liquidity planning. You will establish reliable structures, deliver decision-ready financial insights, and help scale our finance setup, including the implementation and continuous improvement of our ERP system. Your day-to-day: Own day-to-day accounting across our entities, including accounts payable and receivable, bank and balance-sheet reconciliations, accruals, provisions, fixed assets, intercompany transactions, and expense accounting. Independently manage timely and accurate monthly closings under German GAAP (HGB), coordinating external accountants and local requirements for international entities where applicable. Prepare management accounts, variance analyses, cost-centre and project reporting, KPIs, and clear decision materials for leadership and budget owners. Support the annual budget, rolling forecasts, scenario planning, and short- and medium-term liquidity planning. Ensure robust financial controls, documentation, and compliance with accounting, tax, and internal policies, coordinate VAT and other recurring filings with external tax advisors. Lead the finance workstream for ERP implementation and optimization, covering process design, data migration and quality, testing, cutover, training, and post-go-live stabilization. Your profile: Degree in Business Administration, Finance, Accounting, or a comparable field. An additional accounting or tax qualification is a plus. jobs.title: Sales Manager - Berlin
jobs.description: Company Description We’re Checkout.com . You might not know our name, but companies like eBay, Spotify, Klarna, Uber, and Sony do, because we’re behind many of the digital experiences you use every day. We are where the world checks out, enabling over 10 billion transactions yearly for more than one billion global shoppers. Whether you want to book a holiday, order food, renew a subscription, or check out online, there’s a good chance our tech powers the payments behind the scenes. Our platform helps the most ambitious businesses deliver effortless digital experiences, at scale. If you want to do career-defining work, you’ve come to the right place. We move fast, think globally, and believe great teams are built by hiring exceptional people with conviction, curiosity, and the desire to make an impact. With 20 offices across six continents and London as our HQ, we’re shaping the future of fintech – and we’re just getting started. Job Description Checkout.com is actively looking for an enthusiastic and talented Payments Senior Sales Manager to join our Commercial Payments Team to drive rapid growth across various industries for our revolutionary online payment solution. If you are a driven and focused salesperson with a proven track record of success selling direct payment solutions to enterprise companies, in a high-growth and competitive environment, this is the role for you. In return, on top of a tremendous working environment, we offer you an unrivaled uncapped recurring commissions plan, hybrid work model and competitive benefits package. The Senior Sales Manager will play a key role in growing Checkout.com ’s payments footprint. They will be responsible for selling Checkout.com ’s full payments technology stack to middle market and large enterprise organizations. Along the way, you'll collaborate closely with various in-house talents across Technology and Business to position our capabilities, products, services and solutions effectively with prospects. jobs.description: Gestalte das perfekte Foodji-Erlebnis Ein großartiges Produkt allein reicht nicht – echte Kundenzufriedenheit entsteht durch starke Beziehungen und einen klaren Blick auf die Entwicklung des Kundenportfolios. Du machst den konkreten Nutzen und Mehrwert von Foodji sichtbar und schaffst damit die Grundlage für langfristige Partnerschaften. Deine Mission bei Foodji (Enterprise-) Kund:innen begleitest du von der Testphase über den Vertragsabschluss durch die gesamte Customer Lifetime. Für dein Kundenportfolio übernimmst du Verantwortung und sorgst dafür, dass Kund:innen Foodji erfolgreich nutzen, langfristig bleiben, wachsen und uns weiterempfehlen. Stabile und vertrauensvolle Beziehungen zu zentralen Entscheider:innen und dezentralen Stakeholdern baust du gezielt auf und entwickelst sie weiter. Verantwortung für die Gesundheit und Weiterentwicklung deines Enterprise-Kundenportfolios – von der KPI-basierten Analyse der Account Health bis zur Ableitung gezielter Maßnahmen. Vertragsverlängerungen bereitest du aktiv vor und erkennst Kündigungsrisiken frühzeitig – auch wenn sie zunächst nur an einem einzelnen Standort auftreten. Steuerung von internen und crossfunktionalen Projekten zur Weiterentwicklung des Customer Success Bereichs. Das bringst du mit Mindestens drei Jahre Erfahrung im Customer Success Management sowie nachweisbare Erfahrung in der Steuerung von Retention-, Vertragsverlängerungs- und Churn-Kennzahlen über ein Kundenportfolio hinweg. Du wirst Teil unseres Finance & BI Teams und arbeitest eng mit Controlling und BI. Wir bauen zusammen die Zahlenbasis, auf der Foodji gesteuert wird und gehen Fragen aus dem Business gemeinsam an: schnell, präzise und mit dem Anspruch, jede Frage bis zur Entscheidung durchzudenken. Deine Mission bei Foodji Ist-Zahlen & Treiber: Du analysierst gemeinsam mit dem Controlling die operativen Treiber hinter den Ist-Zahlen und leitest konkrete Maßnahmen ab für alle Teams. jobs.title: Founding Implementation Manager (Italian Speaking)
jobs.description: About Sona Frontline work keeps the world running. Restaurants, hospitals, schools, nurseries, airlines, stores, emergency services. Together they employ 80% of the global workforce, over 3 billion people, and they're among the hardest businesses anywhere to run. By-the-minute scheduling, HR and payroll make them far more operationally complex than the average office, yet just 1% of venture funding has ever gone to software built for them. Rising costs, wage increases, labour shortages and tighter regulation have made fixing that urgent. Sona is the AI-native workforce management platform for frontline organisations, with agents that match staffing to real demand and take the admin load off managers. That's a $500bn+ market the software industry has mostly walked past. We've raised over $100M from N47, Felicis, Gradient and Northzone, signed more than 100 enterprise customers across the UK and US, and opened offices in London, New York, Austin and Lisbon. More on working at Sona here . About the Role We're hiring a Founding Implementation Manager to lead how Sona implements in Italy. You'll be the first person doing this job in the market, and you'll own every Italian implementation from kick-off to go-live. In the UK, our implementations follow an established playbook. In Italy there isn't one yet, so working out how we do this well is part of the job. Expect a lot of unknowns and plans that change. You'll build a clear picture of the lay of the land, take the route that gets us there fastest and bring in the right people from Product, Commercial, our customers and local specialists when they're needed. Day to day, that means keeping a lot of moving parts pointed in the same direction, with stakeholders across our customers, Product and the wider Sona team, and relationships that are rarely simple. jobs.title: Outbound Account Development Representative - France
jobs.description: Who we are Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale. Working at Samsara means you'll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that's shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you'll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term. We have offices in Munich, Paris and Amsterdam and we offer remote working from Germany, France, The Netherlands and London. Our European headquarters are based in London. jobs.title: Control & Estimation Intern
jobs.description: About Us Harmattan AI is a next-generation defense prime building autonomous and scalable defense systems. Following the close of a $200M Series B, valuing the company at $1.4 billion, we are expanding our teams and capabilities to deliver mission-critical systems to allied forces. Our work is guided by clear values: building technologies with real-world impact, pursuing excellence in everything we do, setting ambitious goals, and taking on the hardest technical challenges. We operate in a demanding environment where rigor, ownership, and execution are expected. About the Role We are developing the flight control systems of our next-generation autonomous platforms, which are embedded and subjected to extreme operational constraints. As with any aeronautical system, no model is perfect: aerodynamic effects, actuator dynamics, wind, payload changes, damage or degraded sensors are never fully captured by the physics-based models we rely on. These unmodelled dynamics are one of the main sources of performance loss and risk for a controller, especially at the edge of the flight envelope. To push the boundaries of control, we are working on estimating these disturbances online and compensating for them in real time through adaptive control and robust estimation. Your mission The goal of this internship is to design, implement and validate a framework for estimating and compensating unmodelled physics disturbances, in order to improve the robustness and performance of our flight controller in extreme and uncertain conditions. Responsibilities Literature review: Survey existing approaches to disturbance estimation and adaptive control Algorithm implementation: Develop and implement the selected estimation and compensation algorithms within our simulation environment. Performance evaluation: Assess and compare the performance and robustness of the developed methods against classical baselines. Embedded constraints: Ensure the solutions are compatible with real-time execution

Today, more than 250,000 companies use Mollie to get paid, manage money and grow — with products designed to be simple, scalable, and dependable. You'll also get involved in team projects as they come up, working alongside the Financial Reporting team, FP&A and other finance colleagues. jobs.title: Interim Senior Community Manager
jobs.description: Who we are We believe travel can create Citizens of the World. When people cross Europe slowly, by train, they come back more curious, more open and better able to understand people unlike themselves. With colleagues from more than 50 countries, our diversity sparks curiosity, insight and a culture of openness, which is essential to understanding our travellers and one another. Three values connect everyone at Interrail: we lead with our purpose, we own our impact, and we choose for growth. We work in a hybrid way, from our office in Utrecht and our homes across the Netherlands. We’re on the search for... Someone who has built a community for a brand before, and who can bring ours to life online and offline. Since 1959, Interrail has been more than a rail pass. We’re now building it into a cultural movement, and our community is where that movement becomes real: the deeper you travel through Europe, the more the journey changes you, told by the people who lived it. In 2027 our community moves into the Interrail app and website. Our product and technical team builds the platform. You make it a community: you shape the community vision, bring the first members in, and create the moments, online and in real life, that make travellers come back and help each other. The Brand team shapes what Interrail stands for and how it shows up wherever travellers meet us. We own our brand platform and positioning, and our community, bringing The Interrail Effect to life through the people who’ve travelled with us. We work closely with Product, Social & Community, Creative & Content, CRM, and the PR & Partnerships teams to keep every touchpoint consistent and culturally sharp. This is a nine-month interim contract. The team meets in the office a minimum of twice per week, so you’ll be required to join those days to work alongside your colleagues. The recent trade crisis—sparked by Trump-era tariffs—has made customs the single most complex challenge for global businesses. For many, it’s the difference between keeping supply chains moving or grinding them to a halt. That’s where we come in. The Customs Technology team at Flexport is leading the charge. We are building the systems that help entrepreneurs and global brands navigate complexity, stay compliant, and keep the world’s goods flowing. The opportunity:  Customs brokerage is one of the largest, most under-innovated opportunities in logistics. Legacy customs brokers are stuck with outdated systems and manual processes—they simply can’t adapt fast enough. Flexport is growing fast because we’re different. We are the only big tech company in the space, and the only freight forwarder that got founded after the launch of Netscape. jobs.title: Platform Engineer - Data Resilience and Recovery platform
jobs.description: Build and own a self-service, multi-tenant platform that keeps the critical data of 20+ customers recoverable Do you like building platforms that other teams consume, at scale, across private and public clouds, with security and tenant isolation as non-negotiables? At Schuberg Philis, the world is shifting from traditional backup to data security and resilience. We’re looking for a Platform Engineer to strengthen our Data Management-as-a-Service (DMS) team and help us build the next generation of our platform. About the Team The DMS team builds and runs a shared, fully segregated data resilience platform that serves more than 20 of our customers. Customer teams consume it through self-service, and they handle their own day-to-day backup and restore operations. That means you won’t spend your days on job monitoring, restore tickets or backup schedules. Your customers are internal and external engineering teams, and your product is the platform they build on. You’ll join a dedicated group of data security experts within our larger Services Team and work closely with our sbp.cloud team, who operate our self-built sovereign cloud solutions. With our plan-build-run approach, you take end-to-end ownership: you design it, you build it, you run it. The Challenge Running one platform for 20+ customers means solving the hard problems of platform engineering: Multi-tenancy by design: strict isolation of data, access, and performance between customers, on shared infrastructure. Self-service at scale: APIs, guardrails and automation that let customer teams onboard and operate independently, without tickets. Scale and resilience: 4,000+ protected endpoints and more than 25,000 recovery points generated daily, on a dedicated private cloud spanning multiple availability zones. Heterogeneous workloads: Oracle, MS-SQL, SAP, Sybase, PaaS, container platforms and VMs across VMware VCF, OpenStack, AWS, Azure and Kubernetes. Op de human interest-redactie maken we de journalistieke producties voor Libelle. Het team Je maakt deel uit van het Financial Analytics Service team, dat momenteel bestaat uit 40 mensen met diverse achtergronden in de gezondheidszorg en data-analyse. Het team is verantwoordelijk voor het implementeren en onderhouden van onze oplossingen en benchmarks, die zowel medische specialisten als de planning- en controleteams in ziekenhuizen ondersteunen. Onze oplossingen helpen ziekenhuizen en medische specialisten bij maandelijkse rapportages over prognoses, het aanpakken van capaciteitsvraagstukken, portefeuillebeslissingen, het verbeteren van patiëntenzorgpaden en andere belangrijke strategische keuzes. Relevante werkervaring: Je hebt 0–2 jaar werkervaring en affiniteit met de financiële sector en/of de gezondheidszorg. Data: Je hebt een affiniteit met data en bent in staat om klanten te helpen met optimale inzichten uit onze producten te halen. Communicatie: Je kunt effectief communiceren met diverse teamleden, interne stakeholders en klanten. Je werkt nauwkeurig, signaleert trends en spoort fouten of afwijkingen op. Een proactieve benadering om nieuwe taken op te pakken en kansen te zoeken om bij te dragen. Een WO-opleiding afgerond, bij voorkeur met een focus op gezondheid, data of economie. jobs.description: Senior Mechatronic System Architect | Medical Robotics (m/f/d) Location: Maastricht, Aachen, and Eindhoven region, working mainly on-site with our development partner in Maastricht. Regular travel to Hamburg and to clinical sites, about 2 to 4 days per month. Reports to: CTO About the venture: ROB E ROB E is a Hamburg-based medtech startup and part of the NLC Health Ventures portfolio. We are developing a robotic system that holds and steers a standard transesophageal echocardiography (TEE) probe during structural heart interventions. Interventionalists get stable, reproducible echo views, and echocardiographers no longer have to stand next to the patient in the X-ray field. Our first-generation prototype has been used in a first-in-human study with published results. We are now developing the next generation from scratch as a fully compliant medical device for CE marking and FDA clearance. The team includes a CTO, a System Software Architect and a Head of Quality & Regulatory. The role You are the mechatronic design authority of ROB E. You own the system architecture, the hardware requirements and the technical decisions for the mechanics, drives, sensing and electronics of our robot. You work on site with our engineering development partner in the Maastricht area and steer their team on our behalf. This is a hands-on senior role: you design yourself, review the work of others and make sure the hardware is safe, verifiable and ready for design transfer. Responsibilities Define and own the mechatronic system architecture: robotic device, drives, force and torque sensing, real-time controllers, safety supervisor, power supply and the interface to commercial TEE probes. Translate user and system requirements into subsystem and interface specifications and keep them traceable through verification. Act as technical counterpart to our engineering development partner, from ideation, technology and part selection through design reviews and approval of design outputs. C

jobs.title: Stage Consumentengedrag
jobs.description: Waarom pak je in de supermarkt het ene product wel uit het schap en het andere niet? Ligt het aan de verpakking? De prijs? Smaak? Gemak? Of simpelweg omdat het precies op de juiste plek staat? Bij Growy telen we verse sla, kruiden en microgreens in Amsterdam in onze vertical farm. Vertical farming klinkt misschien ingewikkeld, maar het idee is simpel: we telen planten in lagen boven elkaar, midden in de stad en helemaal los van het weer buiten. Nu onze producten in steeds meer Nederlandse supermarkten te vinden zijn, willen we onze consumenten nóg beter leren begrijpen. Daarom zoeken we een nieuwsgierige en commercieel ingestelde stagiair die zich wil verdiepen in consumentengedrag en inzichten kan vertalen naar echte commerciële kansen. En nee, dit wordt geen stageproject wat ergens in een lade verdwijnt en niemand ooit nog bekijkt, jouw stage gaat voor ons echt een verschil maken! 🌱 Wat ga je doen? Hoe zorgen we ervoor dat meer consumenten Growy ontdekken, proberen én opnieuw kopen? Tijdens je stage ga je bijvoorbeeld: consumenten interviewen en/of focusgroepen organiseren; onderzoeken wat mensen belangrijk vinden bij het kopen van verse salades en kruiden; ontdekken welke drempels consumenten ervan weerhouden een product te proberen; onderzoeken wat juist zorgt voor een herhaalaankoop; kijken naar kansen rondom prijs, assortiment, verpakking, positionering, promoties en zichtbaarheid; kwantitatief onderzoek, zoals enquêtes, opzetten om ideeën te testen; jouw inzichten vertalen naar concrete commerciële en marketingaanbevelingen. Aan het einde van je stage presenteer je jouw belangrijkste inzichten en aanbevelingen aan ons Sales & Marketing team. En als het binnen je stage past, kun je misschien zelfs één van je ideeën in de praktijk testen. De precieze inhoud stemmen we af op de duur van je stage en de eisen vanuit jouw opleiding. jobs.title: Spezialist Werkstofftechnik & Prozessentwicklung (m/w/d)
jobs.description: Über Remloy Seltene Erden sind unverzichtbar für zahlreiche Zukunftstechnologien – von Elektromobilität und Windkraft bis hin zu Robotik und industriellen Anwendungen. Im Mittelpunkt steht das Zusammenspiel von Werkstoffeigenschaften, Prozessparametern und Anlagentechnik – mit hoher Eigenverantwortung und direktem Bezug zur industriellen Praxis. Das können Sie bewegen: Werkstoff- & Prozessentwicklung: Analyse und Optimierung metallurgischer Produktions- und Schmelzprozesse sowie Weiterentwicklung der Verarbeitung von NdFeB-Legierungen. Entwicklung und Umsetzung von Maßnahmen für höhere Reproduzierbarkeit, Effizienz und Prozesssicherheit. Technische Anlagenoptimierung: Analyse des Zusammenspiels von Material, Prozess und Produktionsanlage, Identifikation technischer Schwachstellen

Die liegen bei vielen hundert Behörden, und jede tickt anders. Manches geht digital, vieles nur per Telefon, Mail, Fax oder Post. DocEstate sorgt dafür, dass die Unterlagen vollständig und pünktlich ankommen. Digital, wo es geht. Mit Menschen, die dranbleiben, wo es nicht geht. Unsere Kunden sind vor allem Investoren, Wohnungsunternehmen, Hausverwaltungen und Kanzleien. Deine Aufgaben Behörden melden sich nicht immer von selbst. Du sorgst dafür, dass die Auskünfte trotzdem ankommen. Du rufst bei Ämtern an, fragst nach dem Stand einer Anfrage und findest heraus, wer wirklich zuständig ist. Du schreibst Nachfragen und Erinnerungen per Mail oder Fax, sachlich und so, dass sie bearbeitet werden. Du klärst Rückfragen und sorgst dafür, dass fehlende Angaben schnell nachgereicht werden. Du hältst jeden Kontakt in unserem System fest und behältst Fristen und offene Vorgänge im Blick. Du merkst, wo es im Ablauf immer wieder hakt, und bringst Ideen ein, wie es besser geht. Darüber hinaus sprichst du situativ auch direkt mit unseren Kunden, wenn es Rückfragen zu ihren Anfragen gibt. So sieht dein Alltag wirklich aus Viel Telefon: Behörden erreichst du am besten vormittags, etwa zwischen 8 und 12 Uhr. Das ist deine Zeit, unser Team mit deinen Skills nach vorne zu bringen. Manchmal wirst du zum dritten Mal vertröstet. Wer gern Dinge gründlich zu Ende bringt, ist hier richtig. Du bearbeitest viele Vorgänge parallel. You raise security awareness across the team through trainings and clear guidelines. What helps you succeed: At least 3 years of experience in information security, ideally in a SaaS or software company. jobs.description: Company Overview Metrea delivers effects-as-a-service to national security partners across five domains and more than a dozen mission areas. These include airborne ISR, electronic warfare, secure communications, aerial refueling, special air missions, aerial firefighting, and advanced simulation. We own the whole stack: designing, building, and operating turnkey capabilities that give our partners decisive, asymmetric advantage against rapidly evolving threats. Our operating model is built around three interlocking pillars. The Support Groups provide a global shared-service – spanning people, finance, platform, operations, legal, and engagement. This frees up our Core Groups, who develop and own mission capabilities end-to-end, to focus entirely on delivery. The Market Groups apply a regional lens, ensuring that our agile and adaptable capabilities remain aligned to the wicked problems that matter most to our partners across the Americas, EMEA, and Asia-Pacific. At the heart of our model is a simple but powerful idea: be a true partner with skin in the game. Our partners need effects, not just equipment. By owning the full stack – from the lab to the field – we are able to drive a continuous cycle of innovation that keeps our partners ahead. It s a fast-moving, intellectually demanding environment where talented people are given real responsibility, work on problems that matter, and contribute to an enterprise that is growing quickly and deliberately. Headquartered in Washington, DC, with facilities across the United States, the United Kingdom, as well as Continental Europe and Asia-Pacific. Position Summary Reporting to  Metrea’s  Procurement Manager, th is role  will  primarily  execute and manage end-to-end procurement activities across the UK and EU operations. This role balances day-to-day tactical purchasing with proactive commercial delivery, ensuring continuity of supply, strict cost control, and rigorous supplier contract compliance

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer - Foundations
jobs.description: Ambition has no passport. That belief is why LemFi exists. We're the financial engine for people the world wasn't built to serve, the millions who move countries to build something better and find the financial system hasn't caught up with them yet. We started with remittances: the money people send home to the people they love. Now we run multi-currency accounts, Savings, eSIMs and Credit. Because staying connected to home and building somewhere new are not two separate things. They never were. About the role LemFi's Foundations tribe is the platform backbone every product team relies on. We own onboarding and identity (KYC end-to-end), engagement systems (rewards, CRM tooling, Lemfi cash), and the internal SDKs and architectural standards that let other squads move fast without reinventing the wheel. If it touches how a customer gets onto the platform or how teams build reliably on top of it, it runs through us. We are looking for a Senior Backend Engineer who is at home in Go, cares deeply about building things that last, and has the ownership instinct to drive a system from design to production with minimal hand-holding. You will be a key technical voice in the tribe - setting standards, shipping real product, and enabling the rest of engineering to move faster because of the work you do. What you'll build and own Own and evolve our core identity and onboarding services - KYC flows, verification orchestration and the data contracts that downstream systems depend on. Build and maintain internal SDKs and shared libraries that abstract platform concerns (auth, identity, caching, eventing) so product teams can move without friction. Define and champion cross-platform architectural standards, making opinionated decisions about service design, API contracts and data consistency that the wider engineering org follows. Drive engagement platform capabilities - rewards logic, CRM integrations and Lemfi cash - from spec to production, using AI-assisted development tooling

We move quickly from prototype to production and surface reusable patterns that shape our platform. We operate at the intersection of deployment and development – working closely with OpenAI Research, Product and Partnerships. About the Role As a Deployment Lead, you will define how OpenAI delivers complex systems to Semiconductor customers. You will own how solutions are scoped, built, shipped, and adopted across high-value engineering workflows such as RTL design, verification, and physical implementation. You’ll translate business outcomes into a technical plan, run day-to-day execution across FDEs, Researchers, and Customer Engineers, and partner with customer teams to ensure delivery supports their goals. You will focus on the semiconductor vertical to deploy next-generation AI capabilities. You will own delivery end-to-end: embedding with customers to map workflows and success criteria, ensuring components ship on time, and leading readiness and change management for adoption. Sur ce socle, les Product Engineers et les AI Engineers construisent applications et agents. Les Platform Engineers exploitent l’infrastructure sur laquelle tournent vos pipelines. Les échanges avec les data owners et les équipes de gouvernance du client, la relecture de code entre pairs et l’accompagnement des nouvelles recrues complètent le quotidien.   Vos responsabilités : Construire des pipelines d’ingestion et des modèles de données, avec dbt par exemple. jobs.title: CDI - Senior AI Strategist - Paris
jobs.description: Prenez en main un stream de transformation IA, au contact direct des clients, de la vision aux résultats mesurables. L’IA, et en particulier l’IA agentique, figure parmi les priorités des comités de direction. Chez Artefact, nous sommes des makers. “We Make AI Work” : notre métier n’est pas de commenter l’IA, c’est de la faire fonctionner, à grande échelle, au cœur des grands groupes.  Et tout commence par vous.   Mission En tant que Senior AI Strategist , vous prenez en main un stream ou une mission bien cadrée, avec autonomie sur votre périmètre et au contact direct des clients : vous cadrez, analysez, prototypez et recommandez, vous coachez les consultants juniors, et vous voyez vos recommandations prendre vie avec nos équipes Engineering. Vous commencez là où débute toute transformation IA : par l’ambition du client, son secteur d’activité et ses processus métier, et non par la technologie. Et vous restez un maker : vous ne vous arrêtez pas au slide. Vous construisez vous-même analyses, business cases et démos fonctionnelles (vibe coding, low-code, no-code) que le client peut toucher, et vous développez un domaine d’expertise solide dans un secteur ou une fonction métier. Vous travaillez main dans la main avec nos équipes Engineering (qui construisent et livrent des solutions d’IA agentique) et nos équipes AI Adoption (qui favorisent leur adoption) : vous cadrez les processus cibles et la roadmap de votre stream, Engineering les construit et les livre, et AI Adoption accompagne les personnes dans le changement, dès le premier jour. Activités & Responsabilités Conception de la stratégie et de la transformation IA Vous contribuez à cadrer la vision IA et à la roadmap du stream, qualifiez et priorisez les cas d’usage, et arbitrez entre solutions IA et non-IA. Vous investiguez les processus métier, identifiez les irritants et les causes racines, et proposez des pistes de refonte priorisées, en pensant d’abord lean et en n’utilisant l’IA que là où elle

Pour cela, nous partageons et propageons l’esprit entrepreneur avec des modes de collaboration plus agiles à l’échelle : Des individus , à travers des programmes de formation et l’accélération de projets d’innovation Des équipes , grâce à des expériences d’innovation participative et l’adoption de nouveaux modes de collaboration Des écosystèmes et des organisations , en créant et animant de larges communautés ouvertes (open innovation), mobilisées autour d’objectifs communs Dans ce cadre, nous recherchons un·e stagiaire communication avec une appétence pour les stratégies de communication , afin d’accompagner la chargée de communication au sein du pôle événementiel & communication sur la structuration et le déploiement de la communication d’Adopt AI. Missions En soutien direct à la chargée de communication et au sein du pôle événeme

Pipelines, modèles de données, définitions de métriques, droits d’accès : vous créez et gouvernez ce socle, et les applications et les agents de nos clients s’appuient dessus. Quand un analyste ou un agent demande un chiffre, la réponse est celle de l’équipe finance, accompagnée de sa définition et de sa source. Ce poste est fait pour vous si vous voulez que les métiers et les agents puissent se fier aux données, et les utilisent. Artefact accompagne les plus grandes entreprises du monde dans le déploiement de l’IA : 3 000 AI makers dans plus de 30 pays, plus de 1 000 clients. En France, le département Engineering réunit environ 300 personnes sous la responsabilité du CTO ; vous y rejoignez le chapter AI Applied Engineer, archétype Context & Analytics Engineer.   Activités et responsabilités Avec les équipes métier et les analystes, il s’agit de définir ce que signifie chaque métrique et de vérifier que les données y correspondent. Sur ce socle, les Product Engineers et les AI Engineers construisent applications et agents. Les Platform Engineers exploitent l’infrastructure sur laquelle tournent vos pipelines. Les échanges avec les data owners et les équipes de gouvernance du client, la relecture de code entre pairs et l’accompagnement des nouvelles recrues complètent le quotidien.   Vos responsabilités : Construire des pipelines d’ingestion et des modèles de données, avec dbt par exemple. Mettre en place des contrôles de qualité des données et maintenir le lineage. Construire la couche sémantique et les définitions de métriques, pour que les personnes et les agents utilisent les mêmes chiffres, y compris en text-to-SQL. Définir les règles de gouvernance et les droits d’accès. Construire des pipelines de connaissances pour le RAG : indexation, chunking, métadonnées, permissions. Préparer le contexte exploitable par les agents : métadonnées, définitions,

jobs.title: CDI - AI Strategist Manager - Paris
jobs.description: Pilotez les missions où se jouent les paris IA des grands groupes, et transformez-les en résultats mesurables L’IA, et en particulier l’IA agentique, figure parmi les priorités des comités de direction. Chez Artefact, nous sommes des makers. “We Make AI Work” : notre métier n’est pas de commenter l’IA, c’est de la faire fonctionner, à grande échelle, au cœur des grands groupes. Et tout commence par vous.   Missions En tant qu’ AI Strategist Manager , vous construisez avec les dirigeants de nos clients une stratégie IA crédible, un modèle opératoire adapté et un programme de transformation qui génère une valeur mesurable. Vous êtes le moteur de nos missions AI Strategy : vous les pilotez en autonomie, en garantissez la qualité, les délais et la rentabilité, faites grandir les consultants qui y sont staffés et développez vos comptes aux côtés des Directeurs et Partners. Vous commencez là où débute toute transformation IA : par l’ambition du client, son secteur d’activité et ses processus métier, et non par la technologie. Et vous restez un maker : vous ne vous arrêtez pas au slide. Vous construisez vous-même analyses, business cases et démos fonctionnelles (vibe coding, low-code, no-code) que le client peut toucher, et vous développez un domaine d’expertise solide dans un secteur ou une fonction métier. Vous travaillez main dans la main avec nos équipes Engineering (qui construisent et livrent des solutions d’IA agentique) et nos équipes AI Adoption (qui favorisent leur adoption) : vous définissez les processus cibles et la roadmap, Engineering les construit et les livre, et AI Adoption accompagne les personnes dans le changement, dès le premier jour.   Activités & Responsabilités I. Conception de la stratégie et de la transformation IA Vous définissez la vision IA et la roadmap priorisée des cas d’usage, challengez la pertinence de l’IA et assumez les arbitrages. jobs.title: AI Applied Engineering – Platform Engineer Manager
jobs.description: Mission Des groupes de premier plan font tourner leur IA sur ce que vous construisez. Infrastructure cloud, plateformes de données, chaînes de delivery, serving de modèles, runtime des agents : ces fondations portent à grande échelle les applications et les agents de nos clients, et vous les concevez et les exploitez. Grâce à ce travail, les équipes produit livrent sans risque, tandis que les coûts, la latence et la sécurité restent sous contrôle. Ce poste est fait pour vous si vos utilisateurs sont d’autres équipes d’ingénierie et si la robustesse d’un système sous charge vous intéresse. Artefact accompagne les plus grandes entreprises du monde dans le déploiement de l’IA : 3 000 AI makers dans plus de 30 pays, plus de 1 000 clients. En France, le département Engineering réunit environ 300 personnes sous la responsabilité du CTO ; vous y rejoignez le chapter AI Applied Engineer, archétype Platform Engineer.   Activités et responsabilités Les Product Engineers et les AI Engineers déploient sur les plateformes que vous construisez ; leurs besoins se définissent avec eux, et leur accompagnement se poursuit jusqu’en production. Sur une plateforme de données, les fondations vous reviennent : infrastructure, sécurité, réseau, calcul. Ce qui y circule relève des Context & Analytics Engineers. Le travail se mène aussi avec les équipes IT, sécurité et cloud du client, sous le regard desquelles chaque choix d’architecture doit pouvoir se défendre ; le code se relit entre pairs et les nouvelles recrues sont accompagnées. jobs.description: As an individual contributor sitting at the intersection of engineering and business, you turn complex memory technology and system concepts into accurate, accessible, and compelling technical content. In addition to technical content creation, you will participate in customer first technical meetings to present and support the specifications and technical claims before highly technical audiences. Reporting to Vertical Compute’s Product Marketing Lead, this is a hands-on individual-contributor role with a direct impact on how our technology is understood and brought to market. Create, edit and maintain technical blogs, in-depth whitepapers, application notes, product/technology briefs, FAQs and other long-form technical content. Develop customer-facing datasheets and specification documents based on requirements and parameters defined and approved by Product/Engineering. Create architecture diagrams, explanatory visuals, technical slide content and compelling material for conference talks, abstracts and presentations. Adapt approved technical information for audiences ranging from semiconductor specialists to system architects, partners and technically minded business stakeholders.
